description: The golden corpus for the access-token.v1 wire contract (the decoded header and claims of a user access token). This manifest is the SINGLE inventory: every runner reads THIS file over THESE fixtures (G-70). `reject_by_client` documents are valid against the schema and refused by ParseAccessToken, because they need a comparison JSON Schema cannot make.

accept.why: The ordinary token for go-api and query-api: audience dev-health-api, scope api:access, an organization, ten minutes.
No org_id: the session acts in no organization. Absent is the only form of 'none'.
The token for auth-service's own session routes: audience auth-service, scope auth:session.
exp - iat equals the HS256-compat ceiling (3600 s): the longest lifetime the client accepts.
nbf later than iat and before exp.

reject.why: HS256: a symmetric algorithm is never this token's.
alg none: an unsigned token.
typ JWT is the HS256 token's type, not an access token's.
No kid: the verifier could not name the key.
Empty kid.
jku: a key URL from the token; the verifier takes keys from its configured issuer only.
jwk: an embedded key; never trusted.
x5u: a certificate URL from the token.
crit: an extension the verifier would have to understand.
aud as an array: one token, one audience.
An audience the vocabulary does not name.
query-api is the effective-principal envelope's audience, not a user token's.
A scope outside the closed vocabulary.
auth:session with audience dev-health-api: the scope belongs to the other audience.
Two scopes in one string: v1 carries exactly one.
sub as a bare UUID; the wire form is principal.v1's prn_ id.
No sub.
No sid: every user access token belongs to a session.
sid as a bare UUID; the wire form is session.v1's ses_ id.
A workload principal in a user access token.
A jti shorter than 22 characters.
Plain http issuer.
org_id null: 'no organization' is the absent claim, never null.
An uppercase UUID: one spelling per organization.
iat 0.
exp after 9999-12-31.
exp as a string.
No nbf.
role: not in the claim set; authorization is checked live per request.
email: not in the claim set; authorization is checked live per request.
username: not in the claim set; authorization is checked live per request.
full_name: not in the claim set; authorization is checked live per request.
is_superuser: not in the claim set; authorization is checked live per request.
tv: not in the claim set; authorization is checked live per request.
type: not in the claim set; authorization is checked live per request.
kid ending in a newline: every pattern anchors at the end of the text, not before a final line break.
iss ending in a newline: every pattern anchors at the end of the text, not before a final line break.
sub ending in a newline: every pattern anchors at the end of the text, not before a final line break.
sid ending in a newline: every pattern anchors at the end of the text, not before a final line break.
jti ending in a newline: every pattern anchors at the end of the text, not before a final line break.
org_id ending in a newline: every pattern anchors at the end of the text, not before a final line break.
A third top-level member: the document is the header and the claims only.

reject_by_client.why: exp - iat is one second over the HS256-compat ceiling.
nbf equals exp: the token is never valid.
Two aud members; the second, which a last-wins decoder keeps, is the other audience.
Two alg members in the header.
exp written 1760000600.0: the same number, but not an integer token.
